Container.Name: Lingshu-Home
Container.Overview: A self-hosted personal dashboard for links, browser bookmarks, nested categories and modular widgets. Customize your homepage with a visual editor and Classic or iOS-inspired themes. Choose English or Simplified Chinese before the first start; the saved language also determines example bookmarks and cannot be switched later. SQLite is included; no external database is required. Open the WebUI to complete first-run setup. There is no default administrator password. Keep the /data mapping to preserve your database, saved icons and instance encryption keys. This template follows the latest published stable Linux amd64 image and runs as Unraid's appdata user (99:100). Back up appdata and read the upgrade guide before applying an update. Exact version tags remain available for version pinning.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: lingshu home dashboard homepage bookmarks navigation startpage selfhosted
Container.Requires: Linux amd64 (x86-64). Persistent appdata storage writable by UID 99 and GID 100.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Host HTTP port. Keep the container port at 8080. Complete setup on your trusted LAN before configuring remote access.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, saved icons and instance keys. Keep this mapping when recreating or upgrading. Existing directories must be writable by UID 99 and GID 100.

Config.Name: Interface language
Config.Description: First-start language: en (English) or zh-CN (Simplified Chinese). Saved once; later field changes do not switch it. When upgrading from 0.0.1, keep the previous value, especially en for an English instance.

Config.Name: HTTPS-only cookies
Config.Description: Keep false for direct HTTP access. Set true only when using Home through an HTTPS reverse proxy. This setting does not enable HTTPS itself.
